title: Images are attachments, so they are used the way attachments are used

sections.name: words
sections.label: Owner, 2026-11-24
sections.content: Lets use "one way" as much as possible. If images are attachments, then we should use them like we use attachments

sections.name: context
sections.content: Said when asking how source records in an essay's references container are currently linked, for an agent's image (semanticops.com#71 / srs-web#826). Follows vignette cc80d922.
